items.text: Avandu vanyingi vamali kokora kuli vanyara kong'oda amakuva gi ivindu viekoleka hagati hiitu.
Vang'oda ivindu via kwavolerwa na yavo avaari avaloli va moni na moni vi vindu yivio kutura mulitanga, kandi avilwaazi vi likuva yilio.
Inzi kandi O, Wuluyali Zeofilo, mali mulihenzeriza ligali nokolohiza vindu yivi viosi kutura mulitanga, na galoleki ndi, ni vulahi ku inzi ngong'odere vindu viosi kuli viveeye.
Ngoli ndio kunangwa uduuki kumanya agiligali gi ivindu viosi via wigizwa.
Lilaandizwa lie liivulwa lia Yohana Mubatizi

Mu madiku ga Herodi yaali Mwami Munene wi Vuyuda, yaali ho musaalisi mulala walangwa Zakaria, kutura ku avinyumba yu musaalisi Abija. Mukali weve yalangwa Sabeti; yaali mulala ku avakaana vi kisukururwi chu Musaalisi Haruni.
Vosi vaali avalungi imbiri wa Nyasaye, kandi vaatia ligali nokolonda malago na makuva gu Mwami vugira imbara.
Navuzwa sivali numwana mba, Sabeti yaali umugumba, kandi vosi vaali vahindira ligali.
Lidiku lilala Zakaria yaali naakoraa miyinzi ju vusaalisi imbiri wa Nyasaye mu Litembeli kuli lilohiza lia vuli lidiku lialange.
Yatovolwa nikura kuli mwima gwu vusaalisi, kwingira mu Litembeli liu Mwami, asambe kimuli ku vwali.
Kiduma kenene chavandu vaali ni vasaala ichova ing'inga yukusaamba kimuli.
Engelosi wu Mwami yaloleka kuye nasingiyi ku mukono mulungi gwu vwali, olovega lwi kimuli chasambirwa.
Lwa Zakaria yamulola, yahenda mwoyo kandi naatia ligali.
Navuzwa engelosi yamuvolera, “Utatia mba, Zakaria, kigira Nyasaye ahuliyi lisaala liilio. Mukali woovo Sabeti alakwivulira mwana muyaayi, na ulamugulika Yohana.
Ulakave nuvusangali kandi nuvuyanzi, na avandu vanyingi valakasangala ku liivulwa lilie.
Alakave munene imbiri wu Mwami. Si alinwa iwaini anoho amalwa mba, naye aliizula Roho Mutakatifu kutura munda mwa mama weve.
Aliranyia avanyingi ku avandu va Isiraeli ku Mwami Nyasaye wavo.

Alimiira imbiri wu Mwami weve nu mwoyo kandi ni zinguru kuli ziu muporofeti Elija. Alakahambanyie avababa na avana vaavo kandi; alalomba avibaali na avatatiizaa Nyasaye vaganagane kuli avalungi vaganagana; alaketegekiziri Mwami avandu veve.”
Zakaria yateeva Engelosi, “Inzi ndamanya ndi amakuva yaga? Inzi mbeeye musakulu na mukali wange yakeera.”
Engelosi yamutivulira, “Inzi mbeeye Gabirieli usingiraa imbiri wa Nyasaye; na ndumiywi komoloma na ivi, kandi ngoletere makuva malahi yaga.
Hulira, ulava idimbidi, kandi siulamoloma mba, kuduuka lwayaga galakekoleke, kigira siwasuuvira makuva gange ivi siulamoloma mba kuduuka lwa malago gaange gali twekizwa.”
Avandu valindilira Zakaria, nivagenya ku lilindagilira lilie mu Litembeli.
Lwa yatura ichova, siyaali anyala komoloma navo mba. Vamanya ndi aloli malola mu Litembeli. Navuzwa yagelagela vuzwa makono ma namenya naveeye idimbidi.
Lwa yamala madiku geege guvutumiki mu Litembeli yirana yengo weve.
Inyima wa madiku yago, mukali weve, Sabeti yavereka. Yivisa munyumba ku mieli jitano navoora;
“Kalunu Mwami amali kumanyia zimbavasi zizie ku inzi. Anduliziyi zisoni ziambezaa nazio imbiri wa vandu.”
Lilaandizwa lie liivulwa lia Yeso
Mu mweli gwa sita Sabeti naveeye ninda, engelosi Gabirieli yatumwa na Nyasaye kuzia Nazareti, lidaala lia Galilaya.
Yaali na makuva ku mukaana mugima, uwalangwa Maria, uwaali niyateevwa koleetwa nu mundu mulala uwalangwa Josefu, wi kisukululwi cha Daudi.
Engelosi yazia kuye namuvolera, “Mirembe Maria! Ivi ugasiziywi ni zimbavasi zinyingi! Mwami aveeye harara na ivi.”
Navuzwa lwa Maria yahulira amakuva yaga, yaahenda mwoyo ligali ku makuva geege, naganagana mumwoyo ichi licheliza yili livoora!
Engelosi yamuvolera, “Utatia mba, Maria, kigira Nyasaye akovereye zimbavasi.
Henza! Ivi ulavereka na ulivuula mwana muyaayi na ulamugulika, Yeso.
Alakave Munene kandi alakalangwe, Muyaayi wa Nyasaye Oveeye igulu Ligali. Mwami Nyasaye alakamukole alave Mwami kuli guuga weve Daudi.
Alakamiihi ku avandu va Isiraeli mihiga ni mihiga, Uvwami vwivwe sivulakave nekeheri mba.”
Maria yateeva engelosi, “Yaga galanyalika ndi, kigira inzi mbeeye mugima?”
Engelosi yamutivulira, “Roho Mutakatifu alaza ku ivi, kandi zinguru zia Nyasaye oveeye igulu Ligali zilakukinga kuli kiriri. Kulwayago mwana wa ulivuula alakalangwe Mutakatifu, Mwana wa Nyasaye.
Umanye kali Sabeti mwiko woovo, umali kovereka mwana muyaayi mu vokeere vwivwe. Yigu nu mweli gwigwe gwa sita, wa vandu valanga mugumba.
Kigira ku Nyasaye, si keveeye ho kindu ikitanyalikaa mba.”
Maria yavoola, “Henza inzi mbeeye mutumikiri wu Mwami. Gave ku inzi kuli aga ovooye.” Kunangwa engelosi yatura kuye.
Maria Yageniha Sabeti
Ku ing'inga yeyo, Maria yetegeka, nalomba logendo kuzia vwangu mu lidaala lilala liveeye muvigulu vie Vuyuda.
Yingira munyumba ya Zakaria, nacheliza Sabeti.
Lwa Sabeti yahulira licheliza lia Maria, mwana yakina nuvuyanzi munda mwimwe. Sabeti yizula Roho Mutakatifu,
na yahanzuka numwoyo munene, “ Ivi ugasiziywi ligali hagati ha vakali vosi, kandi agasizwi umwana wa ivi ulivuula!
Inzi nivwaha kali mama wu Mwami wange yaaze ku inzi?
Kigira lwa mbuliyi mwoyo gwi licheliza liilio, mwana akini munda mwange nuvuyanzi.
Oveeye nuvugasu ivi uwa suuvira ndi, agu Mwami yakuvoolera galadukizwa!”
Lwimbu lwi lizominya lia Maria
Maria yavoola,
Maria yamenya na Sabeti ku ing'inga iduuka imieli jivaga, ma ni yirana yengo wavo.
Liivulwa lia Yohana Mubatizi
Ing'inga ya Sabeti yu kwivura yaduuka; ni yivula mwana muyaayi.
Lwa avatende na aviiko veve vahulira ndi Mwami umukoleye zimbavasi zinene, vasangala harara naye.
Maku lidiku lia munane, vaza kokeva mwana, ni venya ku mugulika Zakaria; lieta lia baba weve.
Navuzwa mama weve yavoola, “Awa! Alalaangwa Yohana.”
Vamutivulira, “Simuveeye nu mwiko ulangwa lieta yili mba?”
Kunangwa vagelera baba weve amakono ni vamuteeva lieta liagulika mwana weve.
Naye yateeva kibao cho kong'oda ku, yang'oda: “Lieta lilie ni Yohana.” Vosi vagenya.
Ahene yaho munwa gwa Zakaria gwigulika nululimi lwilwe lwanguha manaamolomaa nakuminya Nyasaye.
Uvuti vwali ku avatende vosi, na makuva yaga galandizwa mu kivala choosi chu muvigulu Ivuyuda.
Vosi avahulira yaga, vaganagana mu mioyo jaavo ni vavoola, “Mwana uyu aliva mundu wa lugano ki?” Kigira agiligali gaveeye havulavu ndi zinguru ziu Mwami ziali kuye.
Ovoporofeti vwa Zakaria
Zakaria, baba wu mwana, yizula Roho Mutakatifu na yaporofeta, navoora:
Mwana yaviruka, nanyoora zinguru mu Roho. Yamenya mwigendanyama kuduuka ing'inga ya yaloleka ku avandu va Isiraeli.
